entities.name: Alberto Vojtěch Frič
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alberto Vojtěch Frič was a Czechoslovak botanist, ethnographer, writer and explorer. He undertook 8 voyages to America, discovered, described and catalogued many species of cactus. South American Indians called him Karaí Pukú ; in Europe he became known as Cactus Hunter.
